mapper.sql: id, project_id, file_id, class_name, qualified_name, package_name, class_type, stereotype, super_class, interfaces, annotations, start_line, end_line, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_class (project_id, file_id, class_name, qualified_name, package_name, class_type, stereotype, super_class, interfaces, annotations, start_line, end_line, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{fileId}, #{className}, #{qualifiedName}, #{packageName}, #{classType}, #{stereotype}, #{superClass}, #{interfaces}, #{annotations}, #{startLine}, #{endLine}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE code_class SET file_id = #{fileId}, class_name = #{className}, qualified_name = #{qualifiedName}, package_name = #{packageName}, class_type = #{classType}, stereotype = #{stereotype}, super_class = #{superClass}, interfaces = #{interfaces}, annotations = #{annotations}, start_line = #{startLine}, end_line = #{endLine}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM code_class WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND qualified_name = #{qualifiedName} LIMIT 1
